entries.title: Stock tab shows each item's limit
entries.body: A gold limit line appears under the item and updates as soon as you set it.

entries.title: A missing config option is reported once, not on every world tick
entries.body: Servers lacking some module config files logged two lines per tick and filled the logs.

entries.title: Switch between CoA and Wildcard while keeping separate characters and module settings
entries.body: Run one world at a time with shared accounts. Wildcard keeps its own progress; CoA companions are unavailable there, and other modules show experimental compatibility. Backups and server updates cover both realms.

entries.title: Updating the game client shows a progress bar on its button
entries.body: No window covers the app while the client updates.

entries.title: Imported servers get the module config files they lack
entries.body: They are created at start and after an update; existing files are never changed.

entries.title: Modules marked Soon stay greyed out
The Bots page is hidden when the module is not on the server
